using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Plugins;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Plugins;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Defines the <see cref="LocalPlugin" />.
    /// </summary>
    public class LocalPlugin
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="LocalPlugin"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="path">The path.</param>
        /// <param name="manifest">The manifest.</param>
        public LocalPlugin(string path, PluginManifest manifest)
        {
            Path = path;
            Manifest = manifest;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the path.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The path.</value>
        public string Path { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the manifest.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The manifest.</value>
        public PluginManifest Manifest { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the dll files.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The dll files.</value>
        public List<string> DllFiles { get; set; } = new List<string>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the name.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The name.</value>
        public string Name => Manifest.Name;

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the version.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The version.</value>
        public Version Version => Manifest.Version;

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is enabled and supported.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value><c>true</c> if this instance is enabled and supported; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</value>
        public bool IsEnabledAndSupported { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the status.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The status.</value>
        public PluginStatus Status => Manifest.Status;
    }
}

using Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Plugins;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Tests
{
    public class PluginManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SaveManifest_LogsWarning_WhenArgumentExceptionIsThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>>();
            var pluginManager = new PluginManager(loggerMock.Object, null, null, string.Empty, null);
            var manifest = new PluginManifest { Name = "TestPlugin", Version = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0) };
            var path = Path.GetTempFileName();

            // Act and Assert
            var result = pluginManager.SaveManifest(manifest, path);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<ArgumentException>(), "Unable to save plugin manifest due to invalid value. {Path}", path), Times.Once);
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SaveManifest_ReturnsTrue_WhenNoExceptionIsThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>>();
            var pluginManager = new PluginManager(loggerMock.Object, null, null, string.Empty, null);
            var manifest = new PluginManifest { Name = "TestPlugin", Version = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0) };
            var path = Path.GetTempFileName();

            // Act and Assert
            var result = pluginManager.SaveManifest(manifest, path);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<ArgumentException>(), "Unable to save plugin manifest due to invalid value. {Path}", path), Times.Never);
            Assert.True(result);
        }
    }
}
